card.name: Bitter taste descriptions, just before the word bitter
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'bitter' or 'sweet' taste word, such as 'taste', 'and', or 'in' in passages about tastes. It also fires on the start of 'bitter' compounds like 'bitters' in 'bittersweet'.

modes.label: Before 'bitter'
modes.description: Linking or verb words that lead into the word bitter when describing how something tastes.
